agency.name: Administración de Servicios de Salud Mental y Contra la Adicción (ASSMCA)

narrNote: No Puerto Rico affiliate appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched and read in-run 2026-10-22); the list covers U.S. states only. Left null — never inferred.
notes: ASSMCA is Puerto Rico's single state agency for mental health and addiction services; its official portal (assmca.pr.gov) was rendered in-run and the phone shown is published in the site footer. Línea PAS is ASSMCA's 24/7 crisis line (page rendered in-run: 1-800-981-0023, also reachable via 988, VRS 787-615-4112); ASSMCA and United Way PR formalized coordination between Línea PAS (988) and 211 in 2026. 2-1-1 de Puerto Rico is operated by United Way de Puerto Rico; 211pr.org rendered in-run with its live service search. Peer/community entries are Puerto Rico's established community recovery and harm-reduction organizations (Iniciativa Comunitaria serves homeless and drug-using populations; Intercambios Puerto Rico is a harm-reduction organization) — included as community recovery organizations, not claimed as peer-led. medicaidSud left null: the Administración de Seguros de Salud (ASES) administers the government health plan whose coverage includes substance-use services, but asespr.org redirected in-run to an unrelated parked link-list page and was excluded per safety rules; no other official ASES URL could be verified, so the field was left null rather than guessed. countyDirectory null: no ASSMCA provider-directory URL was verified in-run.
